newsitem.title: USA: PacifiCorp Centralia unit said off-line.
newsitem.headline: PacifiCorp Centralia unit said off-line.

text.p: One of the two 670-megawatt (MW) units at the Centralia coal-fired power plant in southwest Washington state has gone off line, a source at PacifiCorp, the plant's operator, said Thursday.
PacifiCorp officials were not immediately available to confirm the outage.
No information was available about the length of the outage, but it was believed to be fairly routine.
Centralia's other 670 MW unit is said to be operating at normal rates.
PacifiCorp, the operator, owns a 47.5 percent stake in Centralia.
